steps.text: Battle Mat in the middle of the table
Choose or draw a Tyrant; its card, chip and die left of the Battle Mat
Day Counter card and chip (set to 1) below the Tyrant card
Set aside the Tyrant's own Tyrant Encounters (blue); box the other Tyrant cards
Shuffle the {deck} Encounter deck; draw (Tyrant's days - 3) cards and shuffle them with the Tyrant Encounters
Special Encounters 001, 002, 003 in order on top of the Encounter deck (story side up), left of the mat
Shuffle Loot and Trove Loot separately, chest side up, right of the mat; 4 Lockpicking Dice nearby
Baddies of the Tyrant card's types: facedown 1Pt, 5Pt and 20Pt Active Stacks above the mat
Each player: Gearloc Mat, Gearloc Chip on its starting Health Chips, Ini Die and Stat Dice; reference sheet nearby
Your 16 Skill Dice in a storage tray; starting Skills (circled on the reference sheet) into their mat slots
Pick a Party Leader for tie-breaks and a game mode (Adventurer Mode to start)
Pools of Atk, Def and Effect Dice plus the D6 below the Battle Mat
4 Lane Marker Chips, 4 Baddie Ini Dice and Health Chip stacks above the Battle Mat
Round Counter Die on R1 at the top of the Ini Meter; GARG and Baddie Skills Reference nearby
Reach and defeat the Tyrant before the Day Counter runs out
Out of Baddies in a stack? Reshuffle that stack's defeated Baddies
Each day: New Day, Encounter, Reward and Recovery phases
